ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

ModuleAnchor.helper: Used to create #anchor-links on the page. Letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

EyebrowText.helper: Optional. Small label shown above the heading. Formatted text and links are allowed.

Heading.helper: Required. Main heading shown in the feature card. Formatted text and links are allowed.
Heading.placeholder: Connect the tools behind your workflow.

IntroText.helper: Required. Supporting copy shown below the heading. Formatted text and links are allowed.
IntroText.placeholder: Show the platforms, services, and systems that support a modern operational stack.

PrimaryButtonText.helper: Optional. Primary button text. The button only displays when text and link are both set.

PrimaryButtonLink.helper: Optional. Enter the web address for the main button.

PrimaryButtonOpenInNewWindow.helper: Open the primary button in a new browser tab.

SecondaryButtonText.helper: Optional. Secondary button text. The button only displays when text and link are both set.

SecondaryButtonLink.helper: Optional. Enter the web address for the second button.

SecondaryButtonOpenInNewWindow.helper: Open the secondary button in a new browser tab.

CenterIconClass.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

CenterImage.helper: Optional. Image used instead of the center icon.

CenterIconColor.helper: Choose the icon color from the available options.

OrbitItems.helper: Add orbit items in display order. Image takes priority over Icon Class. Angle is optional and should be a number from 0 to 359.

Label.helper: Enter the text visitors should see for this link.

IconClass.helper: Optional. Enter a Font Awesome icon name, such as fas fa-heartbeat or fas fa-briefcase. Browse free icons on FontAwesome.com.

Image.helper: Optional. Uploaded logo or icon image. Takes priority over Icon Class.

IconColor.helper: Choose the icon color from the available options.

OrbitNumber.helper: Choose which dotted orbit ring should contain this item.

Angle.helper: Optional. Custom starting angle in degrees, for example 45. Leave empty to auto-position by display order.
